hero.title: Ensure You Are Always Audit-Ready and On Time
hero.subtitle: Saras offers a centralized, intelligent system to track, manage, and report on all regulatory obligations, so you never miss a deadline.

features.title: A Framework for Total Compliance
features.subtitle: Key features designed to provide structure and peace of mind.

items.title: Intelligent Calendar
items.description: Get proactive reminders for every filing date, renewal, and statutory deadline across all jurisdictions.

items.title: Maker-Checker Flow
items.description: Guarantee accountability with a two-step validation system that ensures every task is prepared and verified correctly.

items.title: HOD Oversight
items.description: Provide department heads with a real-time, bird's-eye view of compliance status across the entire organization.

detailSection.title: Enhance Accountability and Reduce Risk
detailSection.description: At the heart of the platform is a robust Maker-Checker workflow. This guarantees every compliance task is prepared by the right team member and verified by an authorized reviewer before submission, minimizing errors and enhancing accountability across the board.

cta.title: Go Beyond Checklists. Achieve True Compliance.
cta.subtitle: Stop managing compliance in spreadsheets and emails. Move to an intelligent system that provides structure, visibility, and peace of mind for your entire organization.
